instruction: Please help me install the Jupyter extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Jupyter extension (ms-toolsai.jupyter) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies the extension is installed by checking if 'ms-toolsai.jupyter' appears in the list of installed extensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: Executes 'code --list-extensions | grep ms-toolsai.jupyter' which directly checks if the Jupyter extension is installed
Metric logic is correct: is_extension_installed properly implements containment checking for extension IDs
Data flow is semantically correct: Command output (string) -> containment check -> returns 1.0 if extension ID found, 0.0 otherwise
Complete coverage: Evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement (extension installation)
Expected value is correct: 'ms-toolsai.jupyter' matches the extension ID from the source URL
No state dependency issues: Command-line check works anytime after installation, no UI state or postconfig needed
Robust edge case handling: Returns correct scores for both installed and not-installed cases
